budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were reviewed and signed with printed totals.
Board noted repeated questions on the cost of the recycling and trash components; the new contract will require each component's cost to be submitted. No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: one of the questions that has been repeatedly asked has been on the costs of recycling portion as well as the trash program

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town received a grant from MRPC for Summer Street; contract received and reviewed by Town Counsel. No amount printed.
budget_items.quote: kerry has received the contract for the grant that town received from mrpc for summer street

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Cost sharing between town and employees moves to 75/25 as of July 1.
budget_items.quote: noted that as of july 1st we'll be going to 75/25 of cost sharing split between the town and employees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Manager said employees would save about 10% under tiering with little or no effect on providers.
budget_items.quote: in almost all instances employees would be saving about 10% with little or no effect on their current providers.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave said a few thousand dollars could make a significant savings for the budget.
budget_items.quote: noted that a few thousand dollars could make a significant savings for our budget

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board discussed storm-related costs cited in the Unitil request (generators, lost food, housing). No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: noted all of the issues incurred as a result of the storm, costs of generators, lost food, housing for them

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Staff working with Unitil to understand the financial impact to customers; board not comfortable with information received. No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: to get a better understanding of what the financial impact could be to the customers
